subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should this PR define the public `sessions.activity`/`session.activity` Gateway contract and plugin task/tool hooks now, or should it wait for the canonical per-session activity design?
rationale: The branch adds public protocol and plugin SDK surfaces while the canonical activity issue still has unresolved attention, stale-run, child-rollup, and persistence semantics.

options.title: Align with canonical activity contract
options.body: Define the Gateway activity schema and ownership semantics first, then update this PR or a successor to match it.

options.title: Accept this narrower contract
options.body: Maintain the current RPC/event/hooks as the public contract and own follow-up compatibility work if the broader design changes.

options.title: Defer plugin hooks
options.body: Keep any internal/UI activity slice but remove the plugin SDK hooks until maintainers accept the public extension contract.

recommendation.title: Align with canonical activity contract
recommendation.body: Define the Gateway activity schema and ownership semantics first, then update this PR or a successor to match it.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest available owner signal across recent Gateway/protocol/plugin API history and the canonical activity-contract area.
